CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 4
   C. 16
   D. 5

2. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

3. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

4. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

6. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 1000 m²

7. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 2, 3, 6
   B. 1, 6
   C. 3, 6, 9
   D. 2, 4, 6

8. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 27.6

9. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

10. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

11. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 30
   C. 75
   D. 40

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

11. A — 1

12. D — 40

2. Substitute values: P = 2(15 + 5)
3. P = 2(20)
4. P = 40
Final Answer: 40 cm
